note: Profiles convert detector output to qa-pii-v1. Legacy model labels remain mapped so the deployed checkpoint can mask safely until it is retrained. routing_only_labels are masked alongside the qa-pii-v1 identity taxonomy but are not identity PII themselves -- Octo's checkpoint natively emits these as clinical/administrative PHI classes, and this list lets it mask them without expanding qa-pii-v1 itself, or scoring them: the evaluation taxonomy only ever mirrors entity_labels. See ADR 006.

octo.note: The deployed Octo checkpoint uses legacy labels; qa-pii-v1 training emits canonical labels directly.

synthify.note: Synthify's address is composite and remains one ADDRESS span.

berts.note: Berts MedRoBERTa/CamemBERT-bio/BERT labels map to qa-pii-v1. DISEASE is the checkpoints' own spelling for the clinical routing-only label this taxonomy calls DIAGNOSIS (see ADR 006); PROCEDURE has no target and stays unmapped, dropped the same way Octo's own PROCEDURE class is.

mdeberta.note: mDeBERTa's 36 labels (teams/mdeberta). STREET, ZIPCODE and CITY are separate spans that the composite-address rule merges. Clinical labels keep the platform's names (ADR 006 and 007); NATIONAL_ID is a merge of Steuer-ID and SSN in this checkpoint, so it stays its own routing-only label instead of taking the global NATIONAL_ID to INSZ_NISS alias.
